test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Steady
solution: The correct answer is '**Shaky**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the word '**Steady**' is '**Shaky**'. • **Steady**: developing, growing or happening gradually and at a regular rate. (नियमित गति से और क्रमशः विकसित होता, बढ़ता और घटित होता हुआ) • *Example: a **steady** increase/decline...* • **Shaky**: not firm; weak or not very good; (अस्थिर, डाँवाँडोल; कमज़ोर, बहुत अच्‍छा नहीं) • *Example: The table’s a bit **shaky**, so don’t put anything heavy on it.* **Correct Answer:__** *Shaky.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Tabular**: presented or arranged in a table. (तालिका या सारणी में प्रस्‍तुत या व्‍यवस्थित; सारणीबद्घ) • **Dedicate**: to give all your energy, time, effort, etc., to something. (किसी काम में अपनी शक्ति, समय आदि लगाना) • **Constant**: happening or existing all the time or again and again. (निरंतर, लगातार) 32:T589, The correct answer is **'to change'.**
